QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] Seeking the Snakes
QuestInfo.0: The Turtle Anima blame the Snakes for poisoning the water. Meet the Snakes and hear their side of the story.
QuestInfo.1: The Turtle Anima blame the Snakes for poisoning the water. Meet the Snakes and hear their side of the story.
QuestInfo.2:
While searching Laguna, you encountered a group of Snake Anima, and joined forces with them to defeat a pack of Specters.
As a show of good faith, you offered to cure the Snakes' infected. Their leader, #bHinya#k, invited you to try.
